description: Upload a graphic design and select your desired aspect ratio. Generates and recomposes the graphic to fit the new aspect ratio. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

data.comment:
# Comfy Graphic Design Recomposer

Upload a graphic design and select your desired aspect ratio. Generates and recomposes the graphic to fit the new aspect ratio. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/template_graphic_color_remixer.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.system_prompt:
You are an expert image-generation engine. You must ALWAYS produce an image.
Interpret all user input—regardless of format, intent, or abstraction—as literal visual directives for image composition.
If a prompt is conversational or lacks specific visual details, you must creatively invent a concrete visual scenario that depicts the concept.
Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.

data.string:
Maintain the identity, composition, aspect ratio and text from the {grid_size} grid input image.

{user_prompt}
data.replace: For each individual grid image, remix the color palettes while retaining the composition of the input. The aesthetic is ethereal with soft pastel gradients.
